hero.h1: Kibay Sparkling – Organic Sparkling Wine with Mango & Passion Fruit
hero.intro: A refreshing organic sparkling wine crafted with Dominican mango and passion fruit. Perfect for any occasion.

crafted.heading: Crafted in the Dominican Republic
crafted.body: Born from the sun-drenched soil of the Caribbean. Our wine captures the essence of the tropics, balancing the sweetness of ripened mangoes with the vibrant acidity of passion fruit. Naturally fermented. Carefully crafted.

process.heading: Fermentation & Wine Process
process.body: We use traditional fermentation methods to create fine, persistent bubbles. The process respects the integrity of the fruit, ensuring a clean, crisp finish that dances on the palate without being overly sweet.

organic.heading: Organic Ingredients & Natural Profile
organic.body: No artificial flavors. No synthetic additives. Just pure, organic fruit grown under the Caribbean sun. Our commitment to organic farming protects the land and delivers a purer taste experience.

tasting.heading: Tasting Notes
tasting.nose: Vibrant tropical bouquet dominated by fresh mango and hints of citrus.
tasting.palate: Crisp acidity balanced by natural fruit sweetness. Fine, elegant effervescence.
tasting.finish: Clean, refreshing, and moderately long with a lingering tropical aftertaste.

enjoy.heading: How to Enjoy Kibay
enjoy.body2: Perfect as an aperitif, or paired with light seafood, ceviche, soft cheeses, or fruit-based desserts. Its versatility makes it the ideal companion for beach sunsets or elegant dinners alike.
